title: Machine learning predicts inadequate urate response to low-dose febuxostat in gout
summary: Data from 340 male gout patients (an observational cohort and two clinical trials) receiving febuxostat 20 mg/day for at least 3 months were pooled; 68.9% and 51.8% were non-responders in short- and mid-term follow-up. LASSO selected serum urate, triglycerides, age, BMI and CRP, and a stochastic gradient descent classifier on these five features reached an AUC of 0.873 (95% CI 0.763-0.942) in the internal and 0.706 (95% CI 0.636-0.727) in the external test set. External performance is weak and the data are retrospective pooled data.
ai_technology: LASSO feature selection and a stochastic gradient descent classifier

evidence.tested: Internal and external test-set evaluation on pooled cohort and trial data (n=340).
evidence.unknown: Whether predictions would change treatment decisions; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts inadequate response to low-dose febuxostat
